name: Gyakuten Higurashi Saiban ~Curry Naru Gyakuten~
original_name: 逆転ひぐらし裁判～カレーなる逆転～
source:
A curry related crime has been committed, and Keiichi must fight to prove his innocence. This short game features the cast of Higurashi conducting a trial with gameplay straight out of Ace Attorney.

[From [url=https://github.com/07th-mod/ace-higurashi-attorney]07th-Mod Github[/url]]
translation:
一起与咖喱有关的犯罪事件已经发生，庆一必须奋力证明自己的清白。这款简短的游戏以《逆转裁判》中的游戏玩法为主角，由Higurashi的演员们进行审判。

[来自[url=https://github.com/07th-mod/ace-higurashi-attorney]07th-Mod Github[/url]]
